title: Shop Schedules
wikitext:
Below is a list of all '''Shop Schedules''', including when they are open or closed. Note: All buildings and homes in Stardew Valley are "locked" on all [[Festivals|festival]] days where the festival begins before 7pm (''i.e.,'' all festivals other than [[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]] and [[Spirit's Eve]]). [[The Sewers]], [[Community Center]], [[Movie Theater]], and the [[Spa]] will remain open. Shops and homes remain locked all day, even if the player does not attend the festival. The exceptions to this rule are the [[Desert Festival]], [[Trout Derby]], [[SquidFest]], and [[Night Market]], where homes and shops are open, and time continues to pass during the festivals.
